briefdescription.para: Appends the escape sequence of a control character.

detaileddescription.para: Writes the usual escape of the character (\\0, \\a, \\b, \\t, \\n, \\v, \\f, or \\r), or \\xHH for the other ones. Used for the characters of the messages and of the names that would otherwise reach the console and the output files unchanged. Defined in src/expression-formatter.cpp.

text
The text to append to.
c
The control character.
The usual escapes for the characters that have one; the other ones, including DEL, as \\xHH.

memberdef.argsstring: (std::string &buffer, char32_t code, std::string_view escape, std::size_t count)
memberdef.name: append_hex

briefdescription.para: Appends an escape and a fixed number of hexadecimal digits.

detaileddescription.para: Used by expression_formatter::append_character(); the digits are lowercase, the most significant first, and the leading zeros are kept, so that the number of digits shows the size of the type.

parameterdescription.para: The text to which the escape is appended.
The escape before the digits ("\\x", "\\u", or "\\U").

briefdescription.para: Appends a text in the plain mode, with the control characters escaped.

detaileddescription.para:
buffer
The buffer to append to.
sv
The text.
The characters selected by is_escaped_in_plain() are written by append_control_escape(); all the others, including the tab, the line feed, and the bytes of the UTF-8 sequences, unchanged.

briefdescription.para: Appends a string, as a quoted literal.

detaileddescription.para: Used by the string operands, so that the empty strings and the leading or trailing spaces are visible, and the control characters do not reach the console. The escapes are those of the character literals, with the double quote escaped instead of the single quote. The bytes above 0x7F are written unchanged, so that the UTF-8 text remains readable.

parameterdescription.para: The text to which the literal is appended.
The string to write; it may contain '\\0'.

briefdescription.para: Appends a code point to a text, as UTF-8.

detaileddescription.para: A value that is not a Unicode scalar value (a surrogate, or a value above U+10FFFF) is written as the replacement character U+FFFD.

briefdescription.para: Appends the text of a string of a wide character type, converted to UTF-8, as the char text is appended.

detaileddescription.para: The text is written by a formatter in the plain mode, so without quotes, with the control characters other than the tab and the line feed, and DEL, escaped, whatever the mode of the caller.

briefdescription.para: Returns the text of a C string held in a buffer of a known capacity.

detaileddescription.para: With npos, the length is computed by the constructor of the view, which reads up to the terminator; otherwise only the capacity characters are searched for the terminator, so that an array without one is not read beyond its end.

parameterdescription.para: The text; it must not be null.
The number of characters that may be read, or npos if the text is null-terminated.

simplesect.para: A view of the characters before the first null character, or of the capacity characters if there is none.

briefdescription.para: Tells whether a character is escaped in the plain mode.

detaileddescription.para: The control characters other than the tab and the line feed, and the DEL character, which can change the state of a terminal, and truncate a text.

briefdescription.para: Converts a UTF-16 text to UTF-8.

detaileddescription.para: The surrogate pairs are combined; an unpaired surrogate is written as the replacement character.

parameterdescription.para: A character type of at least 16 bits, holding UTF-16 code units.

briefdescription.para: Converts a UTF-32 text to UTF-8.

detaileddescription.para:
Char_T
A character type of at least 32 bits, holding UTF-32 code units.
sv
The text to convert.
The UTF-8 text.
Unlike UTF-16, UTF-32 needs no decoding: each code unit is encoded by append_utf8(), which writes the values that are not Unicode scalar values as U+FFFD.

briefdescription.para: C++ source file with non-template implementations for the µTest++ expression formatter.

detaileddescription.para: This source file contains the non-template operator<< overloads of expression_formatter for all standard arithmetic, character, string, boolean, and null-pointer types, std::nullopt, and the named_bool operand. Each overload appends the formatted value — together with an appropriate type suffix where applicable — to the internal string buffer. It also contains the private helpers that write the decimal point, the suffixes, and the characters, and the functions that assign the buffer to the checks.
All definitions reside within the micro_os_plus::micro_test_plus::detail namespace.
This file must be included when building the µTest++ library.
